title: Adult Mouse Skin Dissociation Protocol (on Ice)
author: Andrew Potter
materials: Isolate tissue and place in ice-cold hypothermosol.

steps.title: Remove hair with Nair
steps.instruction: After euthanasia, dab the mouse skin with Nair, wait 30 seconds, then wipe with a wet paper towel.

steps.title: Scrape fatty connective tissue
steps.instruction: Using a scalpel, scrape off the underlying fatty and connective tissue layer before proceeding.

steps.title: Mince skin on ice
steps.instruction: Place the skin on a petri dish on ice and mince with a razor blade and forceps into ~1 mm³ pieces for 3–4 minutes, using a grinding motion to vigorously break up tissue.

steps.title: Add enzyme cocktail
steps.instruction: Transfer exactly 23 mg of the minced tissue into 1 mL of B. Lich enzyme cocktail and keep on ice.

steps.title: Incubate with shaking and trituration
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on ice for 20 minutes. Shake the tube every minute. Starting at minute 2, triturate the suspension 10 times with a P1000 tip that has been cut, repeating this trituration every 2 minutes (i.e., at 2, 4, 6,… minutes).

steps.title: Dounce homogenize
steps.instruction: After the 20‑minute incubation, transfer the digest to a 2 mL Dounce homogenizer and perform 10 strokes with Pestle A every 2 minutes for a total of 4 series (8 minutes). The mixture should become turbid.

steps.title: Settle and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Return the homogenate to a 1.5 mL tube with a 1 mL serological pipette, mix thoroughly, and let it settle on ice for 2 minutes.

steps.title: First filtration of supernatant
steps.instruction: Save 70 % (≈700 µL) of the supernatant, leaving tissue chunks at the bottom. Pass the saved supernatant through a 30 µm filter placed in a 15 mL conical tube. Rinse the filter with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS containing 0.04 % BSA. Keep the flow‑through on ice and retain the filter with the remaining tissue for the next digestion.

steps.title: Add second enzyme aliquot
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of fresh B. Lich enzyme cocktail to the residual tissue chunks in the filter.

steps.title: Second incubation with shaking/trituration
steps.instruction: Incubate on ice for an additional 20 minutes (total digest time 50 minutes). Shake every minute and, starting at minute 2, triturate 10 times with the cut P1000 tip every 2 minutes.

steps.title: Second filtration
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire volume (digest plus added enzyme) to the same 30 µm filter in the 15 mL conical tube and rinse the filter with an additional 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected flow‑through at 300 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C. Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 100 µL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA. Examine cell viability with a hemocytometer using trypan blue.

steps.title: Adjust cell concentration
steps.instruction: Dilute or concentrate the suspension to 1,000 cells/µL for Chromium workflow or to 100 cells/µL for Drop‑Seq.
